implementation: Six explicit auto modes added to existing DiscountPlan/PriceProcessor/Scheduler; no independent price or snapshot engine
Exact regular-to-floor headroom arithmetic and immutable original sale schedule
Transactional stage cohorts, persistent seed, least-served rotation and no special slots for zero-headroom products
Daily/hourly/Flash boundaries, capacity budgets and current-time catch-up
Optional final-day floor policies, disabled by default; stable remaining set before the final day
Bounded 10-product/12-stage read-only previews; automatic prices evaluated on demand
Stock eligibility changes coalesced into existing watchdog/batches; positive-to-positive quantity changes do not rescan campaigns
Additive schema upgrade preserves a live synthetic Manual campaign byte-for-byte; real Production campaign 2 not accessed
limits: Target Production database and real manual campaign 2 were not accessed or tested
Real Woodmart/Elementor design, Redis/WP Rocket/Nginx, live gateway and external services remain unverified
Future cohort preview assumes current membership/stock and continued turns; changed inputs or skipped turns can change future selections; executed cohorts are immutable
Flash capacity is a conservative configurable budget, not a measurement of target PHP-FPM/Redis capacity
Stock eligibility refresh depends on the existing watchdog and batch completion, usually at least one minute
Maximum 366 primary stages and 250000 special-turn entries per campaign; an enabled final-day policy may insert one boundary
No full E2E matrix, large benchmark or full CI run
